notes: "night" (default): each night from time.start_monitoring to time.end_monitoring; "24hr": 24 hours as set by date.type.
Used with period = "24hr": "calendar.day" (default) = 00:00 to 24:00; "monitoring.night" = 12:00 to 12:00 the next day.
Data drawn on the primary Y axis: any of "Temperature", "Wind", "Precipitation"; default c("Temperature").
Data drawn on the secondary Y axis; default c("Wind", "Precipitation").
"speed" (default) summarizes the wind speed column; "gust" the wind gust column.
"combined" (default): one panel with two Y axes; "separate": one panel per data type (in panel.order), each with its own Y axis.
Top-to-bottom order of the panels with panel.layout = "separate"; default c("Wind", "Temperature", "Precipitation").
Wind cut-off line (m/s), default 4; "" = no wind line.
Temperature cut-off line (C), default 10; "" = no temperature line.
Start of each night (period = "night"): clock time ("21:00") or minutes from Sunset/Sunrise ("-30 Sunset"). Default "Sunset".
End of each night: Sunrise/Sunset with minutes ("+30 Sunrise"), a length of time ("5 hours") or a clock time ("06:00"). Default "Sunrise".
Days between X axis labels, default 7.
TRUE lines the temperature and wind axes up so temperature (10 C) is level with wind.ms (4 m/s); FALSE uses temp.range and wind.range exactly as given. Default TRUE.
Temperature axis limits, default c(0, 25).
Wind (and precipitation) axis limits, default c(0, 10).
Precipitation axis limits (mm) of the precipitation panel with panel.layout = "separate", e.g. "0;20"; blank (default) = 0 to just above the largest total.
TRUE: precipitation is a running daily total and is turned into the amount per reading (not used with $precipitation.mm_interval). Default TRUE.
